characters.name: モーセ (Moses)
characters.description: Leader of the Israelites. Older man with a long grey beard, holding a wooden staff, wearing simple earth-tone robes.
characters.visual_traits: older man, long white beard, holding a wooden staff, simple brown robes, soft features, large expressive eyes, innocent expression

characters.name: イスラエルの人々 (Israelites)
characters.description: A group of people, including children and animals, fleeing Egypt.
characters.visual_traits: group of people, men, women, children, simple natural clothing, chibi-like proportions for children, holding small bundles

characters.name: エジプトの軍隊 (Egyptian Army)
characters.description: Pharaoh's army chasing the Israelites. Riding chariots, wearing simple ancient Egyptian armor.
characters.visual_traits: soldiers riding wooden chariots, simple ancient armor, horses, looking fierce but not too scary (suitable for kids)

characters.name: 神様 (God)
characters.description: 神様単独のシーンは既存画像（adam_and_eve のアセット）を流用するため、新たな画像生成やプロンプトの作成は不要です。
